last.verdict: Strong quarter, but weaker user and search-traffic signs sent investors selling hard.

reasons.label: Search traffic wobbling
reasons.text: CEO called Google search referrals "choppy," more volatile late in the quarter; no new licensing deals.

reasons.label: U.S. users slipped
reasons.text: U.S. daily users reportedly dipped from the prior quarter; only 6% year-over-year growth.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Revenue grew 61% to $805M, but the stock had run up and priced in more.

story: Reddit has beaten estimates and guided above forecasts for several quarters. The stock jumped after Q3 2025 and rose about 9% after hours following Q1 2026's 69% growth. Revenue growth has since slowed to 61%, and attention has shifted to Google-driven traffic and user growth.
